name: Barbarian audit: First Blood's damage bonus only applies above 80% target health (#2025)
contract: First Blood 560906 reads 'Increases all damage dealt to enemies above 80% health by 20%'. Its single effect is aura 303 SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_DONE_VERSUS_AURASTATE, EffectBasePoints 20, EffectMiscValue 28. Unit::MeleeDamageBonusDone/SpellDamageBonusDone gate this aura on victim->HasAuraState(AuraStateType(aurEff->GetMiscValue())), i.e. HasAuraState(AuraStateType(28)). But 28 is not a real AuraStateType bit (the enum only defines up to 23, plus the unrelated pseudo-state 32 for poison) -- it is ASCENSION_TARGET_HEALTH_ABOVE_80_PERCENT from the separate AscensionConditionalTargetState enum (SpellAuraDefines.h), used elsewhere only by Unit::HasAscensionConditionalCombatState/GetAscensionConditionalCombatModifier (the SPELL_AURA_OVERRIDE_CLASS_SCRIPTS conditional-combat system, Unit.cpp ~4011-4123), never wired to plain HasAuraState. Before the fix, HasAuraState(28) fell through to the generic 'return HasFlag(UNIT_FIELD_AURASTATE, 1u << 27)' path, a bit nothing ever sets, so First Blood's bonus never applied regardless of target health. Fix: Unit::HasAuraState (Unit.cpp) now special-cases ASCENSION_TARGET_HEALTH_ABOVE_80_PERCENT (28) by delegating to the already-correct health check in HasAscensionConditionalCombatState, the same way it already special-cases AURA_STATE_ASCENSION_POISONED (32). This scenario proves both sides of the gate with the deterministic melee_damage_done metric (fixed base 1000, no hit rolls/variance): the bonus applies while the target is above 80% health, and does not apply once its health drops to or below 80%.

steps.label: Baseline melee damage vs. a full-health target
SETUP: target is still above 80% health
First Blood adds 20% damage against a target above 80% health
SETUP: target is now at 70% health
First Blood's bonus is gated off once the target drops to or below 80% health
